bbox_note: bbox_pct values are approximate (estimated by eye) and are only meant for matching regions; x, y = top-left, w, h = size, in percent of the page.
excluded: Printed page number '9' (bottom right). Map markings inside the panels carry no letters.
page_notes: War comic. Mechanical-style upper-case lettering with exclamation marks drawn as slanted '/'-like strokes and spaces before '!' in many places (spacing before punctuation is not recorded; the text is written with punctuation attached). Two caption bars are dark italic text on pink. Three sound effects, one of them (YAAAR!) a large rotated display word on a red background.

regions.text: THIS RED RAT'S NUMBER TWO ON MY PERSONAL SCORE CARD!
regions.notes: A stray dot sits between RAT and the apostrophe ('RAT.'S'); treated as print noise.

regions.text: THAT DOES IT! NOW LET'S SEE THIS ELECTRONIC SET UP!
regions.notes: Lettered 'ELEC-' / 'TRONIC' across a line break; written as the whole word. 'SET UP' is two words as drawn.

Large yellow outlined display letters rotated about 60 degrees, on a red background. Letter count read as Y-A-A-A-R; the second A is partly overlapped by the third. Exclamation mark is a separate wedge and dot.

regions.text: CAPTAIN, SIX OF THOSE LAUNCHERS ARE LOADED! I CAN SWING 'EM AROUND, RESET THE CONTROLS AND LAUNCH THOSE UKRAS INTO A RED CONCENTRATION POINT ON THE MAINLAND! WE CAN'T WASTE THOSE MISSILES!
regions.notes: Drawn 'AROUND ,RESET' (space before the comma, none after); written with standard spacing. UKRAS is the story's name for the missiles.

regions.text: DON'T LET HIM TOUCH THOSE CONTROLS, CAPTAIN! THE DUMB HEINIE WILL BLOW US ALL UP!
regions.notes: The comma after CONTROLS touches the balloon edge.

regions.text: THERE'S NOT MUCH TIME, MAESTRICH IF YOU'RE SURE YOU CAN REROUTE THESE BABIES, GO AHEAD!
regions.notes: No punctuation is printed after MAESTRICH (as drawn). Drawn 'BABIES ,GO'.

regions.text: HERE'S WHERE THEY WILL LAND, NEAR ZAANDAM! IT'S A BIG SUPPLY CENTER!
AS THE COMMANDOS SLIPPED INTO PROTECTIVE SHELTERS, THE GIANT LAUNCHING TOWERS SWUNG TO NEW POSITIONS...
regions.notes: Dark italic on a pink caption bar; decorated initial 'A'. A dot after COMMANDOS is print noise.

regions.text: THE MEN ARE ALL SET! THE LAUNCHERS ARE SWUNG AROUND! WE'RE READY... NOW!
HERE GOES! AND I HOPE THEY BLAST THAT DEPOT OFF THE MAP!
ADAMS PRESSED THE FIRE CONTROL BUTTONS...
regions.notes: Dark italic on pink; decorated initial 'A' (looks like a stencil A).
Hand-lettered italic on a white rocket trail, tilted.
Small italic on a white rocket trail, tilted.
